en.bdb: The tale of the noble and bad one)

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: virateehaan vakhaaniaa bhale bure dhee sunee kahaanee|

en.bdb: On the basis of the stories listened to, I have described the present state of affairs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਦੁਇ ਚਲੇ ਰਾਹਿ ਉਸ ਥੈ ਤੋਸਾ ਉਸ ਥੈ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhalaa buraa dhui chale raeh us thai tosaa us thai paanee|

en.bdb: A bad and a noble man went on a journey. The noble one had bread and the evil had water with him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੋਸਾ ਅਗੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਭਲਾਈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: tosaa agai rakhiaa bhale bhalaiee a(n)dhar aanee|

en.bdb: Being noble-natured, the good person laid out bread to eat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਹਥੀਂ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਦਿਤੋ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: buraa buraiee kar giaa hathee(n) kadd na dhito paanee|

en.bdb: The evil minded performed his wickedness (and ate up his bread) tut did not offer water to him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾਈਅਹੁ ਸਿਝਿਆ ਬੁਰੇ ਬੁਰਾਈਅਹੁੰ ਵੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhalaa bhalaieeahu sijhiaa bure buraieeahu(n) vain vihaanee|

en.bdb: The noble got the fruit of his nobility (and got liberated) but the evil person had to spend this night of life, weeping and wailing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਜੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sachaa saahib niaau sach jeeaa(n) dhaa jaanoiee jaanee|

en.bdb: That omnicient Lord is true and His justice is also true.
I am sacrifice unto the creator and His creation (because different are the natutes of the two children of the same Lord).
